verdict.rationale: Vercel's Pro plan docs say billing is based on the number of deploying team seats. One seat is included in the platform fee, each extra Owner/Member seat costs $20/month, and read-only Viewer seats are free, so cost clearly scales with the deploying team. The evidence does not explicitly state any minimum seat count or seat-commitment rules, and Enterprise seat terms are absent. missing for 10: explicit minimum seat count/commitment documentation, Enterprise plan seat pricing terms, independent corroboration of seat-cost scaling.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I know whether pricing is per-seat with minimum seat counts that increase cost as my team grows

citations.quote: The Pro plan is billed monthly based on the number of deploying team seats, paid add-ons, and any on-demand usage during the billing period.
Seats with Owner or Member roles: $20/month each.
